one_line: Open on the finished craft, then walk through every step top-down, ending on the same object in the same light.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a rainbow paper-fan dove hangs on a string among ferns; voice (transcript) and subtitle with vowel marks: "ופְרוֹשׂ עָלֵינוּ סֻכַּת". 0:02 cut to the dove on a wall hung with paper chains. No product, no instruction yet.
q1_hook.why: A colourful finished object in motion is a clear picture with text and voice from 0:00 (H1, H6). The first 7 s are a seasonal blessing, not a promise, so the viewer cannot tell it is a craft to copy, and the oil pastels first show at 0:07 (H2, S1).

beats.what: The dove hangs outdoors, then on a wall with a paper chain; subtitles of the blessing
beats.why: The result first, in the season's mood

beats.what: Top-down on the open Giotto Olio Maxi box; "הכנו עם הילדים קישוט לסוכה פשוט"
beats.why: Names the project and the materials

beats.what: Children's hands colour triangles in green, blue, red, orange, purple; "של חברת GIOTTO" in purple
beats.why: Real use, a colour change each shot

beats.what: The finished colour sheet, then folded like a fan; "צבעים רכים ונעימים"
beats.why: The coloured page, then the next step

beats.what: Children fold the strip; "ותקלטו איך הילדים מסוגלים בעצמם"
An adult cuts a dove, slits it, slides in the fan, staples and threads string
The dove hangs among ferns, "והקישוט שלנו מוכן" typed out letter by letter

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "תשמרו ותכינו 🕊️" (save and make). Nothing in the video asks for a comment, save or send.
q2_flow.why: The finished dove opens a question the steps answer, and the same object returns at 0:40 (H5, R4). A new picture every 3 to 4 s keeps it moving (R3). A repeatable craft is worth saving (R7). It runs 44 s, with 10 s before the steps start (R1, R2).

q3_cta.what: Caption only: "תשמרו ותכינו 🕊️" and the tag @giotto_israel. Nothing said or shown in the video. No link, price or where to buy.
q3_cta.why: A single, useful ask with an obvious benefit (C1, C2, R7). But it is only in a caption of 7 words and never said or shown in the video, so most viewers will not see it (C6). It names no recipient and no reason to send (C4).

q4_shown.what: The finished dove 0:00 to 0:07; the Giotto Olio Maxi box with 12 pastels 0:07 to 0:10; children's hands colouring triangles, folding; adult hands cutting and stapling; the finished dove again 0:40. A purple "GIOTTO" text at 0:21. No face, no price.
q4_shown.why: The result is the proof, shown first and last. The brand name is in speech, text and on the box, but the pastels are first handled at 0:10 (S1). It names Giotto once on screen, a light pulse (H3). Children's hands only, no faces (S5, S4).

q5_edit.what: 12 shots in 44 s, about 3.7 s each; straight cuts; the longest detected shot, 0:28 to 0:40, covers folding and cutting. No speed changes. Voice wall to wall; subtitles word by word. Typed text at the end. Ends on the finished dove.
q5_edit.why: A cut by 2.1 s opens with motion (E1). Cuts of 3 to 4 s inside one scene keep a moderate pace (E2). Voice with word-by-word subtitles serves sound off and on (E4). It stops on the payoff (E8).

q6_topic.what: A rainbow dove Sukkah decoration made with children in oil pastels, folded like a fan; serves a parent or teacher who wants a holiday craft.
q6_topic.why: A holiday craft made together answers a real seasonal need (K7). It is calm, warm and wholesome, with a peace message, but not a high-arousal peak (K1, K6). A craft with a timely holiday is easy to save or send (R5).

q7_filmed.what: Phone handheld: a close shot of the dove outdoors in light, then on a wall; top-down over a table covered in plastic with small children's hands colouring; a close top-down view of an adult's hands cutting and stapling; no face.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands put the viewer in the maker's seat (F5), and pastels and paper fill the frame (F4). Real table, real mess, and live motion look native (H8, F8). It is a little shaky and the plastic cover glares (F7).

q8_text.on_screen: White thin subtitles with a shadow, no box, centred about 70 to 75% down, word by word: "ופְרוֹשׂ עָלֵינוּ סֻכַּת" (0:00), "הכנו עם הילדים קישוט לסוכה פשוט" (0:08), "חילקנו את הדף לחלקים" (0:14), "של חברת GIOTTO" in purple (0:21), "צבעים רכים ונעימים" (0:22), "והקישוט שלנו מוכן" (0:42).
q8_text.caption: "תשמרו ותכינו 🕊️". 7 words and the tag "@giotto_israel". No hashtags, no description, no question, no partnership word.
q8_text.why: Subtitles of all the speech let a muted viewer follow (T1, T2), and the vowel marks suit a prayer. They sit in the bottom band (T4). The caption is only a save ask and a tag, with no keywords, hashtags or disclosure (T7, T8).

weak_points: The first 7 s are a blessing, not a promise; the product first shows at 0:07; no partnership word; a 7-word caption with no keywords; subtitles in the bottom band; the maker is never identified.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the finished object first, then top-down hands only, one step per 3 seconds, and end on the same object in the same place.
not_verified: Who the narrator is. Whether the children are hers or a class. Music. Whether the products were gifted. Corrections to coded file: the opening sentence is a prayer ("ופרוס עלינו סוכת שלומך"), not a product line; the pastels are first handled at 0:10, not 7.2 s.
